pending_sql: select id, coalesce(json_extract(payload, '$.subject'), 'Email send') as title, json_extract(payload, '$.to') as recipients, status, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', created, 'unixepoch') as requested, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', created + 600, 'unixepoch') as expires from requests where status = 'pending' order by created desc limit 50
history_sql: select id, coalesce(json_extract(payload, '$.subject'), 'Email send') as title, json_extract(payload, '$.to') as recipients, status, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', created, 'unixepoch') as requested, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', updated, 'unixepoch') as decided from requests where status != 'pending' order by updated desc limit 30
